dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Anti-Homer3 antibody-associated autoimmune cerebellitis/brainstem encephalitis, likely triggered by HHV-7 reactivation (post-infectious autoimmune encephalitis).
1. Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration with anti-Homer3 antibodies (occult malignancy, e.g., lung adenocarcinoma, not yet identified).
2. Primary HHV-7 encephalitis with secondary autoimmune response.
3. Other antibody-mediated encephalitis (e.g., anti-mGluR1, anti-CASPR2, or anti-ITPR1) with HHV-7 as an incidental or contributing factor.
